newsitem.title: MEXICO: Geupec sees "not so good" Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Geupec sees "not so good" Q2 results.

text.p: Mexican bottler Grupo Embotelladoras Unidas SA (Geupec) should report "not so good" profits for the second quarter, compared to the year-ago period, a company official said on Thursday.
The quarter's results could be "slightly below last year," corporate auditor Marco Antonio Abarca told Reuters.
He said the company would be aided by growth in its unit Grupo Azucarero Mexico (GAM), which improved efficiency at a sugar mill after a capital investment in December.
Sales were expected to be flat, compared with sales in the second quarter of 1996, he added.
An eight percent price increase in soft drink prices in April depressed sales for a few weeks, he added. The company is planning another price hike in October of about 7.5 percent.
In the second quarter of 1996, Geupec had revenues of about 261.06 million pesos and net profits of 16.75 million pesos.
Geupec is a franchise of Pepsico Inc and distributes in five western Mexican states.
